description: React component implementing a multi-step onboarding form, managing user input state, fetching initial data, and submitting data via an API.

methods.name: Onboarding()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the onboarding form with multiple steps, managing form state, navigation, and submission.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the onboarding step to the next stage (max 4).

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns to the previous onboarding step (min 1).

methods.name: toggleMarket
methods.description: Adds or removes a market ('US' or 'India') in the form's markets array.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Sends the form data to the API and redirects or shows an error based on response.
